parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to reproduce the Python idna script in Node.js with ESM .mjs files, local imports, manual argparse behavior, black-box executable probing, and no external dependencies.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent probed behavior, then split work into three children: IDNA/punycode, argparse/pyfmt, and the entry point plus end-to-end testing.
parallel.implementation: The argparse/pyfmt child completed its two libraries and the entry child wrote test8.mjs; the IDNA child probed extensively but never wrote idna.mjs or punycode.mjs before cancellation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The copied artifact contained only test8.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and lib/pyfmt.mjs, so the entry point referenced a missing local dependency.
parallel.verification: Component tests existed for argparse and pyfmt, and the entry child syntax-checked test8.mjs, but end-to-end tests could not run because idna.mjs never appeared.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The indispensable IDNA module was absent, the parent did not recover the aborted child scope, and the official evaluator passed 0 of 20 cases.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Python idna, argparse, ESM, local-module, and black-box behavioral parity requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept all work in the main agent, using a long sequence of probes before a todo moved implementation into progress.
serial.implementation: No deliverable files were written; the trajectory ended while the local implementation phase was still only planned or starting.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No artifact files were copied for evaluation, so there was no entry point or library tree to integrate.
serial.verification: The serial run collected many reference outputs but did not run a JavaScript implementation or end-to-end comparison because no files existed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The whole deliverable remained unwritten at timeout, and the official evaluator passed 0 of 20 cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the CLI, ESM, output parity, black-box probing, and no-dependency requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt-level requirements and probed many of the same IDNA edge cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The difference was not requirement awareness; it was execution, since parallel converted some requirements into delegated files while serial never wrote files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched a three-child AgentSwarm with separate file ownership for IDNA, argparse/pyfmt, and the entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no child agents and kept probing and implementation responsibility in the main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced some component work through delegation but exposed a child failure boundary; serial had no delegation boundary but also no completed implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gave children explicit file and export contracts, including the entry point's expected imports from idna.mjs, argparse.mjs, and pyfmt.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface boundary because all context remained inside the main actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel interface contracts were not the failing interface themselves; the contracted IDNA provider simply never delivered the required module.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed argparse/pyfmt and test8.mjs but did not complete the IDNA/punycode implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent the attempt discovering IDNA behavior and did not reach file creation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel was a partial implementation missing one required library, while serial was a no-artifact implementation attempt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The IDNA child was still active until cancellation, and the swarm returned with one aborted child rather than a usable IDNA result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its main trajectory was cancelled before local implementation work completed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a recoverable-looking child failure/result lifecycle boundary; serial failed without a handoff or child result to recover.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared /output across children and ended with a partial final tree containing three files but no idna.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced no final tree entries at all for the evaluator to copy.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's shared tree was incomplete due to a missing delegated component; serial's shared state had no implementation artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had component-level checks for argparse and pyfmt plus syntax checks for the entry point, but no whole-task check after IDNA because the module was missing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial gathered reference outputs and edge-case observations but never verified a JavaScript implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was partial and blocked by the missing delegated module; serial verification was only reference probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after a blocking swarm call returned two completed children and one aborted child, with no parent recovery before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, after a long local investigation phase and before any artifact files were written.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the budget, but parallel exhausted it across delegated components while serial exhausted it in single-agent probing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: This is a both-fail pair, not a discordant official outcome: both current completed status evaluations report solution_passed=false and 0 of 20 samples passed. Parallel differs by producing a partial three-file artifact but omitting the required IDNA module after an aborted IDNA child. Serial differs by never writing any artifact files after spending the budget probing reference behavior.
parallel_contributors: The IDNA/punycode child was aborted and the parent did not recover that required scope.
The final parallel artifact omitted lib/idna.mjs while test8.mjs depended on it.
serial_contributors: The serial main run never wrote deliverable files before timeout.
Its work remained in probing and planning rather than executable JavaScript.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's completed argparse and pyfmt work did not matter to the official result because the missing IDNA module made the program incomplete.
Serial's failure is an ordinary local budget and implementation failure rather than a concurrency pattern.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative explanation with no pass/fail outcome difference
